attributes.description: Startup up axis, z or y.
attributes.name: up-axis

events.description: The viewer finished startup. Fires once per connection.
events.name: cinema-viewer-ready

events.description: A startup or attribute warning that has no command.
events.name: cinema-viewer-warning

events.description: The viewer failed after startup. Fires once and no catalog event follows.
events.name: cinema-viewer-failed

events.description: An unconsumed right click; positions are canvas CSS pixels.
events.name: cinema-viewer-contextmenu

members.description: The validated device record, or null before startup.
members.name: capabilities

members.description: Adapter record and the last failure.
members.name: diagnostics

members.description: Warnings of the last recovery replay.
members.name: recoveryWarnings

members.description: Base URL of the package files; set before connection.
members.name: assetBase

members.description: Read the effective graphics configuration of a viewer without rendering. Uninitialized, pending, recovering and failed states answer with a null configuration; the getter answers during recovery.
members.name: getGraphics

members.description: Move a viewer's live camera to a named view or direction, framed on a target, or to an exact camera state; return the resolved camera.
members.name: setCamera

members.description: Start or stop explicit camera spin at the current pose.
members.name: setSpin

members.description: Stop camera motion and discard stale input.
members.name: stop

members.description: Read all resolved attributes and control state together.
members.name: getAttributes

members.description: Set viewer CSS dimensions and DPR.
members.name: resize

members.description: Apply a validated attribute patch and return resolved state.
members.name: setAttributes

members.description: Set navigation preferences without moving the camera.
members.name: setInput
